sessions.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
learning_objectives: This lecture covers the core concepts of Machine Learning
It introduces the main types of learning: supervised learning (regression and classification), unsupervised learning (clustering), and reinforcement learning at a high level
Key terminologies such as features, labels, datasets, training and testing sets, and models are discussed
The lecture also helps students visualize how a model learns patterns from data and generalizes to unseen examples

sessions.title: Supervised Learning & Algorithms
learning_objectives: This lecture dives deeper into supervised learning techniques
It explains regression methods such as Linear Regression for predicting continuous values and classification methods such as Logistic Regression and Decision Trees for assigning categories
The concepts of underfitting, overfitting, and the bias–variance tradeoff are introduced, along with visual demonstrations of model learning
The lecture also covers evaluation metrics, including Mean Squared Error (MSE) and R-squared for regression, and accuracy, confusion matrix, precision, recall, and F1-score for classification
Emphasis is placed on choosing appropriate metrics and the importance of proper model evaluation
